record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare TORCH_SONG: Fuecoco (1 star), Crocalor (2 stars), Skeledirge (3 stars). The strategy is shared; the only star-indexed value is the AP gain per flame. Units sharing the identifier but not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs no target. After the PP spend the strategy schedules round(4 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower-if-crit) flames at cast time, flame i firing 100 x i ms later. Each flame is aimed at a random enemy (uniform over the enemies on the board at cast time, repeats possible, fixed when scheduled). When a flame fires the caster gains the table AP (1/2/3/6 by stars) whether or not the target is still alive; if the target is alive it takes special damage of 0.5 x the caster's ATK read at cast time (no AP scaling, no crit), and with a luck-adjusted 30% chance is burned for 2000 ms (burning deals 5% of its max HP per second as true damage).

targeting.who: random enemies, chosen per flame at cast time from all enemies on the board
targeting.note: Flames can repeat on the same enemy. If no enemy exists at cast time no flame is scheduled (and the caster gains no AP). Targets that die before their flame fires are skipped for damage and burn but the AP gain still happens.

geometry.shape: no geometry: any enemy on the board can be chosen

effects.scaling: nbFlames = Math.round(4 x (1 + caster AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit else 1)); evaluated once at cast time with the AP the caster has then. A non-positive result schedules none.
effects.resolution: requested 4 -> applied round(4 x AP factor x crit factor); each flame is a DelayedCommand with delay 100 x i ms on the caster's command list, executed by the caster's state update while the caster is updated.

effects.target: the flame's random enemy (if alive when the flame fires)

declaredRaw.of: caster ATK (pokemon.atk read at cast time)

effects.scaling: requested = 0.5 x the caster's current ATK, captured when the ability is cast. handleSpecialDamage is called with crit false and apBoost false, so the caster's AP and crit do not scale the flame (they only change the number of flames). DOUBLE_DAMAGE x2 and strange-steam x1.2 may still apply inside handleSpecialDamage; its crit branch is not taken because crit is passed as false.
effects.resolution: requested (0.5 x ATK) -> applied (= requested here, modulo DOUBLE_DAMAGE / strange steam) -> PokemonState.handleDamage: attacker-side multipliers, SPE_DEF division, min-1 floor (core-mechanics section A), shield first then HP; takenDamage (unused) = shield damage + min(residual, current HP), rounded. Blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (a bounce may reflect damage to the caster unless it holds Protective Pads). Skipped when the target's hp is 0 or less at execution.

effects.scaling: requested = table value by the caster's stars, per flame fired. addAbilityPower(value, caster, apBoost 0, crit false): rounded, then Big Eater Belt on the caster (x1.25 rounded down, positive values), Twist Band irrelevant for a positive value; a NULLIFY_BANDANNA holder gains round(0.2 x value) ATK instead of AP; AP is floored at -100.
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after Nullify Bandanna / Big Eater Belt) -> AP increased by that amount on the caster for the fight (permanent false). The gain happens at execution, before the target's alive check, so it also happens for flames whose target already died. AP gained raises later damage of other abilities but not the flame count already scheduled for this cast.

statusEffects.scaling: chance: 0.3 raised to the exponent (1 - caster luck/100) (capped at 1); no AP or crit scaling of the chance or the 2000 ms. The target's duration reductions apply (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then x(1 - 0.1 per ODD_KEYSTONE)).
statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the flame's damage call, only if the target's hp was above 0 when the flame fired
statusEffects.guards: not applied with IMMUNITY_BURN, runeProtect or a WATER_BUBBLE passive; the burn timer (and burn origin) is replaced only when the new reduced duration is longer than the remaining burnCooldown; a RAWST_BERRY holder eats the berry; GUTS / WELL_BAKED / MAGMARIZER side effects exist (see status code)
statusEffects.effectInCombat: while burning, one tick per 1000 ms of 5% of the burning unit's max HP as TRUE damage attributed to the burn origin, then weather (DROUGHT x1.3, RAIN x0.7), ASSAULT_VEST x0.5, duration-effect reductions, zero for WELL_BAKED or MAGMARIZER holders; also halves the burning unit's received heals (handleHeal)

starBehavior.note: only the AP gain per flame is indexed by the casting entity's stars (6 for 4 stars is not reached at the factory star counts of these units); flame count, damage factor, burn chance and burn duration do not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None: any enemy on the board can be chosen, wherever it stands. Needs at least one enemy at cast time.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast reads the caster's AP and ATK at that moment; AP gained from earlier flames raises the flame count of later casts. Burn from different casts only extends if longer. Pending flames stay on the caster's command list and fire as long as the caster is updated.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 4 flames, flame damage 0.5 x ATK (special), 30% burn for 2000 ms, +1/2/3 AP per flame for the listed stars. Requested = these figures; applied = flame count after AP and crit, AP gain after Big Eater Belt / Nullify Bandanna, burn chance after luck and burn duration after the target's reductions; takenDamage of each flame is not used by the strategy. The three amounts (requested / applied / takenDamage) differ for the damage only after handleDamage's defence step, shield and min-1 floor.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence) - only the abilities base class was read
Crit resolution - only the crit flag used in the flame count was read

Whether the caster's command list is advanced while the caster is silenced, frozen, asleep or resurrecting: only that PokemonState.update calls updateCommands at its start was read (caller of PokemonState.update not traced)
Burn side effects of GUTS_PASSIVE / WELL_BAKED / MAGMARIZER / RAWST_BERRY were only listed, not followed
Luck: where the caster's luck value comes from was not traced
unresolved: Whether pending flames still fire after the caster dies (the command list is on the caster; death handling of commands was not traced)
Which ATK value pokemon.atk holds at cast time (current, buffed ATK per addAttack; the helper was not read here)
Whether the caster's AP could reach a value that makes nbFlames 0 or negative (AP is floored at -100, so the product is at least 0)
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
